description.p: Discover Bing and optional Windows Spotlight wallpapers and save your favorites.
Entdecke Bing-Wallpaper und optional Windows-Blickpunkt-Bilder und speichere deine Favoriten.

ul.li: Download Bing images in HD, Full HD or UHD. Spotlight images retain their original resolution.
Lade Bing-Bilder in HD, Full HD oder UHD herunter. Blickpunkt-Bilder behalten ihre Originalauflösung.
Browse downloaded images offline in 'My collection'.
Durchsuche deine heruntergeladenen Bilder offline unter 'Meine Sammlung'.
Edit keywords, add your own and review optional local AI suggestions.
Bearbeite Schlagwörter, füge eigene hinzu und prüfe optionale Vorschläge der lokalen KI.

Aktuelle Bing-Bilder mit Fotografen-Nachweisen entdecken

Wallpaper im dunklen Design entdecken

Heruntergeladene Bilder offline in Meine Sammlung ansehen

description.p: Browse local downloads in My collection, edit and add personal keywords, rerun local recognition and save reviewed JPEG metadata.
Remember window sizes and maximized state, improve context menus and highlight ignored images.
Use the system UI language on first start, preserve saved language choices, add a resizable image preview window, and support F11 and Escape for fullscreen navigation.
Upgrade to Avalonia 12.1.4 on .NET 10. Add native Wayland with automatic X11 fallback, improve the image preview and saved status, and provide an upstream offline Linux installer.
Replace the app icon across all platforms with the maintainer's hand-drawn landscape artwork.
Add optional regional Windows Spotlight images, source metadata, clean filenames and improved dialogs.
